trim_policy: Trim is display-only, year_group filters offered trim labels. Trim never affects artwork, colors, cabin, telemetry or sensor mappings.
missing_asset_policy: Labelled colour-matched silhouette only; never substitute wrong model/year-group/color or silently reuse front for charging/top.
provenance_policy: G6 2023-2025, G7 2025 and G9 2025-2026 artwork are illustrative AI-generated images; see sources/ai-generated-vehicle-art.json. Manufacturer geometry fidelity requires manual review.
market_note: Catalogue groups are market/year specific where documented; Chinese colors are not asserted as exported-market options. All paint HEX values are approximate visual swatches.
year_color_policy: An exact model year filters paint choices. Year group identifies shared image geometry, and selected trim remains display-only.
